title: Saturday mornings
text: Saturday mornings are his own. His grandad wants help in the yard, the boxing gym on the corner lets kids sweep up in return for a lesson, and the park has a football game every week.

choices.outcome: He carries feed sacks half his size and comes home filthy and proud.

person.about: Has worked the same land for fifty years and doesn't believe in days off.

choices.text: Sweeping up at the boxing gym.
choices.outcome: The old trainer shows him how to hold his hands up. He practises in the mirror every night.

person.about: Has run the corner boxing gym for thirty years.

choices.text: The football game in the park.
choices.outcome: He's the smallest on the field and the hardest to tackle.
